name: SemanticScholar_search_papers
description: Search Semantic Scholar papers with abstracts, TLDR summaries, identifiers, authors, impact counts, and open-access links. Unsorted relevance search uses offset pagination (up to Semantic Scholar's first 10,000 results). Sorted search uses the bulk API: consume each upstream page with next_offset, then switch to next_token at offset 0. Metadata reports exact total_results and whether the database result set is fully retrievable.

query.description: Search query for Semantic Scholar. Use keywords separated by spaces to refine the search.

limit.description: Maximum papers to return. Regular search allows up to 100; sorted bulk search allows up to 1000. A value of 0 returns no records without querying.

year.description: Filter results by publication year. Use a single year (e.g., '2024') or a range (e.g., '2020-2024').

offset.description: Regular search: server result offset (0-9999). Sorted search: local offset within the current bulk page (0-999); reuse the same token until next_offset is null.

token.description: Opaque bulk-page token, valid only with sort. Omit for the first upstream page; use metadata.next_token at offset 0 after the current page is exhausted.

include_abstract.description: If true, best-effort fetches missing abstracts via the paper detail endpoint (only when abstract is missing in search results).

oneOf.description: List of papers from Semantic Scholar matching the search query

tldr.description: AI-generated one-sentence TLDR summary of the paper

url.description: URL to the paper on Semantic Scholar

fields_of_study.description: Fields of study (e.g., Biology, Medicine, Computer Science)

oneOf.description: Error response (single-element array with error details)

retryable.description: Whether the request can be retried

name: SemanticScholar_get_pdf_snippets
description: Fetch a paper's open-access PDF from Semantic Scholar and return bounded text snippets around provided terms. Uses markitdown to convert PDF to markdown. Useful when key details (methods, experimental parameters) are in the full text rather than abstract.

paper_id.description: Semantic Scholar paper ID (e.g., from SemanticScholar_search_papers). The tool will fetch the PDF URL if available.

open_access_pdf_url.description: Direct open access PDF URL (recommended when you already have it from SemanticScholar_search_papers).

terms.description: Terms to search for in the extracted full text (case-insensitive).

window_chars.description: Context window size (characters) before and after each match.

max_snippets_per_term.description: Maximum number of snippets returned per term.

max_total_chars.description: Hard cap on total characters returned across all snippets.

pdf_url.description: The PDF URL that was processed

term.description: The search term that was matched

snippet.description: Text snippet with context around the matched term

truncated.description: Whether output was truncated due to max_total_chars limit

error.description: Error message (only present if status is error)
